verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's AI Object Storage documents bucket lifecycle policies (Expiration, NoncurrentVersionExpiration, AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload) giving users control over data retention and deletion for stored training data/checkpoints, and access token/credential controls limit who can act on that data. However there's no evidence of retention/deletion controls for other data types (compute logs, inference request/response data, cluster metadata) or of any compliance-oriented data lifecycle policy beyond object storage. Missing for 10: retention/deletion controls across non-storage data (logs, inference traffic), platform-wide data deletion guarantees, and compliance documentation (e.g., GDPR/CCPA deletion SLAs).
